findings.title: Browser policy defaults and inspection allowlists disagree across production layers

evidence.detail: Schema defaults to allow-interactions
Shared policy restricts only explicit read-only; permits scroll/design_tokens/tab
Shared helper used on outgoing calls
Second narrower list excludes those documented inspection actions
Missing policy is restricted by this handler
Handler test expects default read-only while shared tests expect absent policy allowed

findings.trigger: Spawn bundled browser-use with no interactionPolicy, or explicit read-only/plan-only and request scroll/design_tokens/tab list.
findings.consequence: Omitted policy may be denied despite the schema/prompt default. Read-only inspection actions advertised as supported are denied by the second gate, causing needless respawn/authorization requests and preventing page inspection.
findings.suggestedFix: Choose the intentional default once and share one structural action-policy evaluator across schemas, prompt, executor and handler. Inspect tab operation and recursive diagnose rather than just top-level type.
findings.acceptanceProbe: Drive schema-valid calls through executor plus handler for omitted/read-only/allow-interactions and plan lineage. Omitted matches chosen default; listed inspection actions work; tab create/close and nested mutation remain denied under read-only.
findings.evidenceVsInference: Default application at spawn was not exercised end to end; handler allowlist rejection is unconditional for explicit read-only and is directly evident. Tests encode incompatible contracts.

findings.title: SDK browser dispatch collapses child ownership into the main run session

evidence.detail: Child parentRunId/parentAgentId owner is attached
Trusted owner captures only mainAgentState
Child/model stamp is discarded
Every browser call uses that same main owner
Session key otherwise includes child ownership
Run cleanup selects only clientSessionId
Cleanup also selects every ownerless session

findings.trigger: Two browser-use children in one SDK run issue actions concurrently; separately, one of two SDK runs sharing a client session completes.
findings.consequence: Children resolve to one browser/tab/log state instead of their intended isolated sessions. Main-run cleanup also targets sibling root runs under the same client session and all ownerless sessions, so another task can lose its browser state.
findings.suggestedFix: Carry authenticated per-call child identity as trusted transport context outside model-controlled input while preserving spoof resistance. Scope run cleanup to the exact root run and track explicit ownership for in-flight sessions.
findings.acceptanceProbe: Two browser children in a fake SDK dispatch must receive distinct session keys. Two root runs under one client ID must survive the other's completion; spoofed owner input must still be rejected.
findings.evidenceVsInference: Identity replacement/key derivation/cleanup predicates are static evidence. Cross-task navigation or teardown interference is a consequence inferred for concurrent callers; no live browser race was executed.
crossReferences: pair09 owns shared job/run/process lifecycle; this finding concerns browser target/observation ownership

findings.title: Diagnose discards step media and returns no verdict for declared success conditions

findings.title: Preview receipts do not guarantee the exact source bytes or dimensions claimed

evidence.detail: Source bytes/hash captured in an initial filesystem read

findings.trigger: Editor replaces a source asset between initial hash/read and Blender opening it; Blender produces an image whose dimensions differ from the request.
findings.consequence: The receipt can bind the produced preview to an earlier asset revision or requested dimensions that were never observed. Metadata caching for Blender inspection has the same hash-before-reopen gap.
findings.suggestedFix: Render/inspect a verified immutable source snapshot, preserve/remap relative dependencies or label their limits, and decode output PNG dimensions. Bind model media to the same artifact bytes/hash and report stale/limited evidence when exact binding is unavailable.
findings.acceptanceProbe: An injected source replacement between read and process open must render the initial snapshot or return stale evidence. Decode and hash the exact returned PNG; wrong dimensions or changed artifact bytes must never retain an exact receipt claim.
findings.evidenceVsInference: Hashing, later path reopen and receipt construction are static evidence. The wrong-revision outcome is an inference conditional on that explicit concurrent replacement; no actual Blender race or malformed-render output was executed.

findings.title: render_ui claims rendering without a host capability or acknowledgement

evidence.detail: Returns UI rendered without consulting host or tool input

findings.trigger: An SDK/headless host exposes render_ui without the Openbuff CLI consumer, or a UI render fails after the runtime acknowledges.
findings.consequence: Model receives UI rendered even when no widget was rendered. The working CLI button does not establish a render contract on other hosts.
findings.suggestedFix: Report widget submission with host delivery state, expose/render only where host capability is negotiated, and acknowledge rendering separately if a client needs that guarantee.

domainAssessment.security: Inspected source/path/filter admission, model-owner spoof rejection, fixed Blender operation language, private CDP pipe and http(s) widget schema. These are meaningful strengths. Browser policy consistency is assessed without prescribing new restrictions against intentional full-access policy. Generic sandbox/process policy is pair09; MCP trust/result policy is pair10. No network/CVE audit or exploit claim.
domainAssessment.correctness: Nine concrete findings cover policy drift, lost browser ownership, diagnostic media/condition semantics, cropped diff extent, missing preview importers, source/hash/dimension binding, preview status, failed capture send, and hostless render acknowledgement. Native parsers/discovery and many actions are production-wired, but not full scene or desktop semantics.
domainAssessment.state-mutation: Reviewed per-session tab/log/recording state, spawn/reconnect/stop single-flight guards, attachment-ID and generation fences, .blend working copies, CAS outcomes and retained artifacts. Static browser owner collapse and source reopen races remain. Shared job/run and filesystem authority are cross-referenced rather than re-audited.
domainAssessment.error-handling: Read per-path image errors, CDP timeouts/close rejection, missing Chrome/Blender, malformed/empty captures, artifact loss, Python exit failures, not-applied and unknown commit outcomes. Some errors are retained accurately; wait/load failures and accepted no-op controls weaken browser contracts, and previewRendered contradicts error JSON.
domainAssessment.performance: Static bounds were inspected: CDP framing/backpressure, logs/network/request/event caps, 600 recording frames, bounded snapshot arrays, image file/attachment caps, Blender 8MiB output and bounded artifact pruning. No runtime memory/latency metric is claimed. read_image eagerly reads all unbounded paths before its total-media cap, and observation/persistence limits need explicit completeness/admission semantics.
domainAssessment.dependency-hygiene: SDK declares pixelmatch/pngjs/ws; CLI declares Jimp/open and pins OpenTUI 0.5.12 and Bun 1.3.5. Rust a11y has no implementation dependency/consumer. Blender is an external executable with no negotiated version/operator capability; 3D advertised formats exceed implemented import branches. No dependency upgrade or external advisory lookup was performed.
domainAssessment.test-coverage: All primary selected test ranges inspected. Two discriminating offline probes passed under pinned Bun (8 assertions), directly reproducing current bug behavior. Existing tests cover pure schemas, parser metadata, pipe/teardown/routing windows and successful conditional Blender scenes, but production child ownership, failed preview booleans, format matrix, source replacement, unsupported-host UI and image status-with-retained-data need contract probes. No real Blender or mounted CLI integration was run.
domainAssessment.api-contract: Reviewed schemas, runtime handlers, SDK conversion/host-view checks, CLI registry/results, native tool catalogs, Rust stub exit contract, ACP and MCP media boundaries. Drift exists in default policy, inspection allowlist, ignored browser options, media/results and .blend preview flags. Engine job guidance export is unwired despite docs. ACP advertises image/audio false accurately; custom plugins do not establish native computer/voice support.

coverageLimits: Read-only current-source review. No source changes, credentials/private images/logs, external messages, model/network calls, or real browser/GUI/audio/Blender launches.

All 18 picker-selected primary ranges across 14 current files inspected; adjacent ranges are explicit samples. Partial source reads do not establish whole-file correctness. Historical roadmap checkboxes are not inspection or maturity evidence.

Native query_index/read_files/read_subtree/audit helpers were not exposed in this Codex session; source/rg and pinned inventory were used, not claimed native tool calls. Root validates the structuralReceipt with the native exported function.

Two fake-CDP/fixture production-helper probes provide unit assurance only. Conditional real Blender tests and mounted native UI tests were read but not run; no platform or provider success rate was measured.

Browser stamp replacement and cleanup predicate are static facts; concurrent browser interference is inferred for explicit overlapping callers. Source/hash-before-reopen is static evidence; wrong-revision output is inferred only under source replacement, not claimed as an observed Blender race.

Native read_image/3D parsers are useful narrow capabilities despite admission/semantic-depth gaps. External custom tools/MCP services may supply desktop/audio actions outside this inspected native surface.

recommendedPlanWork.intendedBehavior: Existing presets remain reviewable prompts; structured guidance is integrated with one real job consumer or its consumption claim is retired. Detected engines expose evidence/confidence.
recommendedPlanWork.smallestScope: One game-dev preset through command selection, existing job/readiness/log/stop consumer and documentation; bounded discovery metadata.
prerequisites: Chosen engine workflow and locally available version
recommendedPlanWork.languageDecision: Do not port engine build orchestration; reuse existing language tools/jobs and native 3D body.
behavioralAcceptanceProbes: One chosen engine build/run/watch workflow surfaces real readiness/failure/stop evidence
Generic Config/addons/Cargo/assets fixture cannot advertise confirmed engine without evidence
recommendedPlanWork.observableCompletionEvidence: Actual consumer search plus end-to-end workflow receipt; remove unsupported runtime-consumption prose if integration is deferred.
recommendedPlanWork.stopDeferRule: Defer rich editor/asset/game operation bundles and unsupported engines until concrete workloads justify them.

recommendedPlanWork.trigger: Desktop a11y stub and native voice loop are absent despite broad body ambition
recommendedPlanWork.intendedBehavior: Advertise only negotiated desktop/speech actions whose observations, permission, cancellation and ownership are implemented.
recommendedPlanWork.smallestScope: Choose one OS desktop observation/action task or one local record/transcribe/playback task; versioned sidecar manifest with typed effect/evidence receipt and TS SDK/CLI consumer.
prerequisites: User-authorized device/network behavior for actual validation
recommendedPlanWork.languageDecision: Rust is justified only for concrete OS API capability; speech component language follows library/platform requirements. TS retains run/effect authority.
behavioralAcceptanceProbes: Capability negotiation refuses unavailable permissions/adapters
Coordinates/frames or timed audio have provenance and bounded limits
Cancel/failure closes resources; a successful action produces inspectable evidence
Actual CLI/SDK workflow works on the declared platform
regressionChecks: Stub must continue fail-loud until replaced
recommendedPlanWork.observableCompletionEvidence: Live platform/task receipt and held-out workload metrics, not passing role-name/stub tests or dependencies alone.
recommendedPlanWork.stopDeferRule: Defer when browser/image capabilities satisfy the selected workload; never mark generic computer or voice completed by historical plan checkboxes.

verification.kind: offline unit probes of current behavior
verification.interpretation: Tests assert current undesirable behavior to distinguish hypotheses; they are reproduction evidence, not regression tests proving fixes.

searchCoverage.negativeLimit: No implemented native desktop/audio tool or consumer found within these searched roots; Rust a11y positive match is an explicit stub. Absence does not cover arbitrary user-installed external tools.
searchCoverage.receiptMeaning: Exact inventory paths and read ranges record inspection, not a full-line audit guarantee.
